many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != grid[0][0]]
    if not pts:
        return g
    bg=grid[0][0]
    # The non-background color marks an incomplete rectangle; color its missing perimeter cells.
    rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    color=next(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if g[r0][c]==bg: g[r0][c]=2
        if g[r1][c]==bg: g[r1][c]=2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if g[r][c0]==bg: g[r][c0]=2
        if g[r][c1]==bg: g[r][c1]=2
    return g
